Set a tuning run's pick beside the published one

Source: R/tune_pick_report.R
knw_tune_pick_report.Rd

After a change upstream (a link build, placement, a flow reload) the first question is whether the pick moved. This answers it for one species x stage from two tuning tables: the run's (knw_tune_score() or data/tune/dev/<key>_tune.csv) and the published one (data/tune/<key>_tune.csv). It says which rule each recommends and at what gradient limit, whether the published rule is still in the run's one-SE region, and how far its score sits behind the run's best, beside where it sat in the published table. Deviances are compared only in units of their own run: a rebuilt evidence changes the visits, so raw held-out deviances of the two runs are not on one scale.

Usage

knw_tune_pick_report(tune, published = NULL)

Arguments

tune

the run's tuning table: rule, grad_max, recommended, in_region, ddev_best, se_diff and n_visits.

published

the published tuning table for the same species x stage, with the same columns, or NULL where none is published.

Value

One row: rule_run and grad_max_run (the run's recommended rule), rule_published and grad_max_published, same_pick, published_in_grid (the published rule was scored in this run), published_in_region (NA when not in the grid), published_ddev and published_se (its distance behind the run's best and that distance's standard error, in this run), published_ddev_was and published_se_was (the same in the published table), n_visits_run and n_visits_published.

Examples

pub <- data.frame(rule = c("mad>=0.5|g<=0.07|none", "mad>=0.75|g<=0.09|none"),
                  grad_max = c(0.07, 0.09),
                  recommended = c(FALSE, TRUE), in_region = c(TRUE, TRUE), ddev_best = c(4, 0),
                  se_diff = c(6, 0), n_visits = 4858)
run <- transform(pub, recommended = c(TRUE, FALSE), ddev_best = c(0, 9), se_diff = c(0, 5))
knw_tune_pick_report(run, pub)   # the pick moved to 7 %, and the published 9 % rule left the region
#>                rule_run grad_max_run         rule_published grad_max_published
#> 1 mad>=0.5|g<=0.07|none         0.07 mad>=0.75|g<=0.09|none               0.09
#>   same_pick published_in_grid published_in_region published_ddev published_se
#> 1     FALSE              TRUE                TRUE              9            5
#>   published_ddev_was published_se_was n_visits_run n_visits_published
#> 1                  0                0         4858               4858
